text:
maria: Heads up, deploy-bot stopped the v2.9.3 image publish to prod at 09:12 UTC — manifest pushed but EU mirror failed verify.
deploy-bot: publish aborted: mirror verification failed for eu-west-1, missing layer object sha256:af3c2b4e. Marked as partial-publish.
aj: copying logs, seeing HTTP 200 for manifest but S3 mirror returned 404 for one layer.
maria: exact error from mirror: "GetObject: NotFound - object does not exist". Weird — upload step claimed success.
jen: any chance of eventual consistency? how long has this been in that state?
ci-cd-bot: build 4821: pushed manifest sha256:8f2d... ; started regional mirror job 09:10:25 UTC ; mirror job finished with warnings 09:11:58 UTC.
tim: if prod has a partial set of layers we must not serve that tag. Options: 1) retag+republish with new tag, 2) promote previous pinned digest (safe rollback), 3) force reupload to region and verify.
maria: preference is to rollback to previous pinned digest to preserve SLOs and avoid risk during this change window.
aj: +1. Retagging/pushing new image in the middle of the release window risks consumers already pulling the broken tag.
jen: provenance/attestation status? do we lose attestation for the manifest if a regional mirror misses a layer?
sre-oncall: attestation exists for the canonical registry region (us-west-2) but mirror verification flag prevented cross-region attestation copy. So eu-west-1 shows no attestation entry; verifier treats that as untrusted.
maria: ok — action: immediate rollback to pinned digest  sha256:c3d9... that we validated in canary earlier. Create rollback release note and block new pushes to v2.9.3 tag until we have a republish plan.
ci-cd-bot: rollback to sha256:c3d9... scheduled: deploy pipeline triggered to 3 prod nodes.
aj: I'll open an infra task to re-run the mirror job and force reupload for eu-west-1 once we confirm rollback is stable.
tim: add a short postmortem template item: how did manifest push claim success without ensuring all regions completed? Maybe we need mirror preflight checks.
jen: created issue IR-2894 with steps and assigned to @sre-oncall, added label release-blocker. Link: https://issues.internal/IR-2894
maria: thanks. ping @sre-oncall when rollback finishes so we can update release notes and notify CS.
sre-oncall: will monitor, will post status here.
ci-cd-bot: deploy pipeline finished: rollback to sha256:c3d9... completed 09:18 UTC, health checks passed.
maria: perfect. leaving v2.9.3 tag frozen. We'll schedule a republish window tomorrow during the change window and coordinate retag+attestation copy.
aj: quick follow-up: can we add an explicit mirror-complete check into deploy-bot before it publishes the final tag? sounds like the right mitigation.
tim: agree. Filing follow-up GH PR for deploy-bot verify step.
jen: adding note to postmortem: temporary mitigation = freeze tag, long term = mirror preflight + attestation reconciliation.
maria: thanks all. I'll draft a short slack announcement to prod channels and update the release notes. :thumbsup:
